tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The company shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

The tenderer should invariably have to submit prescribed quantities of sandalwood oil samples i.e. 50gm, 2Nos. in suitable packing duly seal along with test report MSDS/COA. The said samples should be submitted irrespective of the tenderer being existing supplier/previous suppliers / new tenderer etc. without fail to KS&DL Bengaluru from the date of releasing tender till 4:00PM of last date of sample submission. The technical bid is liable for rejection in case of non-submission of samples, within the prescribed date and time. Only one sample will be tested at KS&DL, Bengaluru and the Lab report should conform to the specification given. If the tested sample result is negative, the bid shall be rejected. The other sample will be preserved at KS&DL, Bangalore. Decision on lab report given by KS&DL is final and binding on the bidders and no further legal action shall lie on the same. Declaration to be filled as per Appendix - I if not the bid will be rejected
All terms and conditions as per uploaded bid documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical bid format (Appendix-A) is to be filled and uploaded
Format of Self -declaration (Appendix - G) is to be filled and uploaded
If the tenderer is a MSE, upload the NSIC certificate as prescribed in Appendix-E.
If the tenderer is a MSE, Format of Self - Declaration of MSE Registered with NSIC (Appendix - E) is to be filled and uploaded
Forma to Self- Declaration (Appendix - F) is to be filled and uploaded
Income Tax PAN No. or equivalent in case of importer
GST / GST Registration number and copy of Company Registration Certificate has to be uploaded
Format of Self-Declaration of Documents Furnished in Appendix-A i.e. Appendix - D is to be filled and uploaded
Format of Enquiry Sample Undertaking (Appendix - I) is filled and upoaded
Appendix - M :Proforma for Performance Statement for the last three years is to be filled and uploaded
Appendix - L: Format of Undertaking of Criminal Case/Conviction is to be filled and uploaded
If the tenderer is trader/authorized agent compulsorily upload the manufacturing authorization letter as per Appendix -P
If the tenderer is a manufacturer compulsorily upload Appendix - P1.
Appendix - M1 :Format of Certificate to be attached from the purchaser at Column 7 of Appendix - M is to be filled and uploaded
Storage License copy of the bidder should be uploaded compulsorily. If it is not applicable, it is compulsory to upload Appendix-R (Format of Undertaking by way of AFFIDAVIAT (NOTARISED)

Trader should upload Manufacturer License Copy issued by the local authorities/regulatory bodies/Government for distillation/production of Santalum Album (Indian Sandalwood oil) and the same applies for Manufacturer also.
Appendix - L: Format of Undertaking of Criminal Case/Conviction is to be filled and uploaded
Appendix - Q: Format of Self -declaration is filled and uploaded
Appendix-R1: Format of Undertaking by way of affidavit(Notarised) is to be filled and uploaded.

a. If the tenderer is Non MSEs, upload last three preceding financial years turnover certificate (i.e., i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) along with copy of audited balance sheet and profit and loss accounts duly certified by Chartered Accountant & ITR) for the years mentioned above as proof in this regard. b. If the tenderer is MSEs, upload last two preceding financial years turnover certificate (i.e., 2024-25 and 2025-26) along with copy of audited balance sheet and profit and loss accounts duly certified by Chartered Accountant & ITR for the years mentioned above as proof in this regard.
